demowebshop-wishlist-button-missing.description: The 'Add to wishlist' control is not present on the live demowebshop.tricentis.com site (checked both the /desktops category listing and individual product detail pages). Other QA projects testing this same demo instance have independently reported this as a known issue, indicating a site-side limitation rather than an automation defect.

epam-corporate-overview-report-removed.description: The hometask specifies downloading the 'EPAM Corporate Overview 2023' report from the 'EPAM at a Glance' section of epam.com/about. As of the current live site, no report by this name exists anywhere on the page - only the UK Modern Slavery Statement, Code of Ethical Conduct, and a Nordic Sustainability report are present. This indicates EPAM discontinued or relocated this specific report since the hometask was authored, not an automation defect.
